trust_decision.summary: Page-derived values (img alt/src, og:image, video description) that site extractors interpolate into HTML template strings are trusted as safe markup; extractor output is only URL-resolved (resolveContentUrls) in buildExtractorResponse and never passes the DOM attribute sanitizer _stripUnsafeElements that the fallback paths use.

landing_point.why: The advisory names 'unescaped attribute interpolation in site extractors' and the regression test uses the X article header image alt; the template literal with raw ${alt} is the obvious first hit.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API Defuddle#parse()/parseAsync() (and node Defuddle(), CLI `defuddle parse`) via buildExtractorResponse for every extractor returning contentHtml
fix_sites.module_kind: core pipeline (central output sanitizer, shared by sync and async extractor paths)

fix_sites.entry_point: same as above (wordCount now counted on sanitized HTML)
parse() on Substack note pages (og:image meta)
parse() on Substack note pages (note img largest src)
parse()/parseAsync() on YouTube watch pages (video description text)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/defuddle.ts:1674-1701 (buildExtractorResponse, reached from sync path src/defuddle.ts:843 and async path src/defuddle.ts:731) — the core class, not an extractor

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report says 'in site extractors', so a solver escapes the named template literals and argues the core Defuddle class already sanitizes and is out of scope; leaving the central output unsanitized leaves every other unescaped extractor template (grok, chatgpt footnotes, youtube video id, hackernews) open.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Extractor output must keep legitimate markup: YouTube/Bilibili embed

O6_input_shapes: double quote in an attribute value closing the attribute and adding an on* handler (img alt)
javascript: URL in img src (handled by the central _stripUnsafeElements pass, not by escaping)
raw HTML tags in element text content (YouTube description)
values from meta tag content (og:image) vs values from DOM attributes (img src/srcset)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Schema.org text fallback places JSON-LD text/articleBody (entity-decoded) directly into response.content with no sanitization
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not a site extractor and not attribute interpolation; it is the main pipeline's schema fallback, a neighbouring feature
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the central fix, different method (parse retry loop) far from buildExtractorResponse

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Extractors that inject page JSON HTML into the document and return contentSelector (Substack body_html, NYT blocks) bypass buildExtractorResponse and go through the main pipeline, which never calls _stripUnsafeElements (only standardize's attribute allowlist and a javascript: <a> unwrap)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Content goes through the normal DOM pipeline, which the advisory text describes as already sanitized; only template-literal output was reported
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/extractors/substack.ts:40 and src/extractors/nytimes.ts:104 feed src/defuddle.ts:822; standardize in src/standardize.ts:483 and src/standardize.ts:189

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Footnote href="${url}" interpolated raw (already present; covered only by the central sanitizer)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Citation URL taken from the page, assumed to be a URL; same style as the reported sites

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Shared conversation footnote builder interpolates footnote.url/text raw (base class for chatgpt/claude/gemini/grok)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A base-class helper in a second file, which a solver fixing individual extractors would not see

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Embed iframe src interpolates getVideoId() which comes from the decoded ?v= query parameter (src/extractors/youtube.ts:985)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Video id looks safe, so a maintainer would not escape it; same file as a fix site, but the fix left this line alone

O8b_injection_room.sibling: data-timestamp="${segment.start}" attribute interpolation in the shared transcript builder
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Numeric-looking field from the fetched transcript JSON; utility shared by YouTube and Bilibili

O9_family: XSS via improper output encoding (CWE-79/CWE-116) in HTML built from template strings

O10_build.project_tests: vitest (TZ=UTC vitest run); tests/fixtures.test.ts covers extractors through HTML fixtures, plus tests/x-article-surrogates.test.ts, tests/youtube-videodata.test.ts, tests/schema-fallback.test.ts, tests/svg-sanitization.test.ts

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap alt/src in escapeHtml() in XArticleExtractor.extractHeaderImage only (it doesn't stop javascript: src and leaves the other extractors and the central output unsanitized).

out_of_scope_notes: Main pipeline (non-extractor) output never runs _stripUnsafeElements; with standardize:false the attribute allowlist is skipped too (src/defuddle.ts:1010-1014). This is a general pipeline concern, not extractor interpolation.
